items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Sidney DeParis, Jimmy Harrison, and June Clark that used to be with Louis... All of them were in that band.

ctx.x: Them kind of things, but out of Detroit. So Wilbur was that type of musician, you know, laying the parts. Sidney was more gutbucket. He ended up with Charlie Johnson and made a big name around here. Sidney DeParis, Jimmy Harrison, and June Clark that used to be with Louis...
